final: WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_list_price, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS across_media_type_avg FROM per_media_type) SELECT p.media_type_name, p.avg_list_price, p.avg_bytes_per_millisecond, p.avg_bytes_per_millisecond / o.across_media_type_avg AS relative_avg_bytes_per_millisecond FROM per_media_type AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.across_media_type_avg IS NOT NULL
